npmCi.rule: npm ci accepts a committed lockfile when every dependency edge resolves to a locked entry whose version satisfies its range. It builds the ideal tree from the lockfile with the root read from package.json; only missing or invalid edges are re-resolved from the registry, and any ideal-tree node the lockfile lacks or locks at another version fails with EUSAGE ("are in sync"). Root records that differ from package.json only mark flags suspect; entries nothing depends on are pruned, not reported.
